_note: Batch 9: ten REAL Perth nature and outdoor wellness providers researched from public information on 10 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'nature' practice category (created on import) covering forest bathing, eco therapy, outdoor fitness, hiking groups, wellness retreats, surf therapy and equine assisted therapy. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Copy is strictly factual — what the session physically involves, who runs it, funding pathways (NDIS/Medicare) and published prices. No treatment-outcome or mental-health claims are repeated from provider marketing, even where the providers make them themselves. Byford and Oakford added to the South East region.

listings.name: Mindful in Nature
listings.blurb: Belinda guides forest bathing (shinrin-yoku) walks in bushland and gardens within about an hour of the Perth CBD, and also works in the South West. Walks are deliberately slow — roughly 2km over two to three hours, with long pauses for stillness and sensory exercises rather than distance covered. Nature journaling, workshops and workplace sessions are also offered.
listings._source: mindfulforestbathing.com.au — services, walk length/distance, Perth + South West coverage and contact email confirmed; no fixed address, phone, prices or timetable published

listings.name: Liminal Place
listings.blurb: A clinical psychologist who holds sessions outdoors instead of in a consulting room — walking side by side, with an initial assessment by video call first. Group hikes, multi-day trips and corporate programs run seasonally. Sessions are Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Fridays at varying locations, and seated or flat-ground options are available.
listings._source: liminalplace.com.au/eco-therapy — clinical psychologist, session days, accessibility options, sliding-scale fees ($200 low / $230 reduced / $265 full), Medicare rebates and bulk billing for Noongar people, email confirmed; no street address or phone published

listings.name: Back to Nature Ecotherapy
listings.blurb: An NDIS-registered outdoor practice running counselling, animal-assisted sessions, art and music therapy, exercise physiology and community-access programs in natural settings around Perth. Programs are built around each participant's own plan and goals rather than a fixed class timetable, and include therapeutic respite and retreat options.
listings._source: backtonatureecotherapy.com.au — service list, NDIS funding and phone confirmed; street address, email and prices not published

listings.name: Harmony Pastures
listings.blurb: A Byford property running equine assisted therapy and learning, therapeutic riding and hippotherapy. Sessions involve grooming, groundwork, observing the herd, leading horses and supported riding, and can be booked individually, as a family or in groups. Self-managed and plan-managed NDIS participants are welcome and progress notes can be provided.
listings._source: harmonypastures.com.au/equine-assisted-therapy — Byford location, service list, session activities, NDIS acceptance, phone and email confirmed; published pricing is package-based (five sessions $1,350; NDIS plan-managed $1,100; first session free) so no per-session priceFrom recorded

listings.name: Stablemindz
listings.blurb: Social worker Liz Dos Santos runs ground-based equine sessions on a small Oakford property. The main offering is the seven-session Horse Wisdom Program for people aged 13 and over, alongside corporate team days. No riding is involved — the work happens on foot alongside the horses. NDIS registered.
listings._source: stablemindz.org/equine-assisted-therapy — address, practitioner qualification, seven-session program, minimum age 13, no-riding format, NDIS registration, phone and email confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Ocean Heroes
listings.blurb: A volunteer-run WA charity that gets autistic children and adults into the surf, started in 2016 and now with thousands of participants behind it. Free community events run at beaches around the state, including Trigg Beach in Perth, with wetsuits, boards, lifejackets and instructors supplied. Weekly Surf Experience sessions can be booked using NDIS funding.
listings._source: oceanheroes.com.au plus Humanitix event listing — WA charity founded 2016, free events, equipment and instructors supplied, Trigg Beach sessions, weekly Surf Experience with NDIS funding confirmed; no public phone or email, contact is via the site's form

listings.name: Perth Bushwalkers Club
listings.blurb: One of the oldest and largest bushwalking clubs in Western Australia, with a program of graded day walks most Sundays and Wednesdays plus multi-day hikes, base camps and navigation courses. Walks are both on-track and off-track, mostly within about an hour's drive of Perth, and the club is a HikeWest member.
listings._source: perthbushwalkers.asn.au — walk types and days, coverage within an hour of Perth, HikeWest membership and walks-coordinator email confirmed; the club's only postal address is a PO box (Applecross North) so no venue recorded, and membership fees are not published on the page checked

listings.name: Strive for Fitness
listings.address: Kings Park Road, West Perth WA 6005
listings.blurb: Vanessa Forbes runs outdoor fitness sessions in Kings Park, meeting near Sticky Beaks café on Kings Park Road. Boxfit and short midday sessions are the mainstay, aimed at people fitting training into a work break, with group and one-to-one programs for adults and children. Sessions run by appointment.
listings._source: striveforfitness.com.au/locations/kings-park — meeting point, Boxfit and midday format, by-appointment booking, phone and email confirmed; prices and a fixed timetable are not published

listings.name: Positive Lifestyle Training
listings.blurb: Outdoor group fitness, running clubs and personal training held at beaches and parks across the western suburbs — Leighton, City Beach, Swanbourne, Mosman Park, Peppermint Grove and Dalkeith — plus lunchtime sessions in the CBD and Fremantle. Equipment is brought to the session, so there is no gym to join.
listings._source: positivelifestyletraining.com.au — session types and the list of beach/park locations confirmed; no phone, email, timetable or prices published on the site's home page

listings.name: Kookaburra Yoga
listings.blurb: A retreat centre on ten acres of bushland in the Perth hills, with a seasonal creek, native forest and an octagonal yoga shala. Alongside weekly classes it runs a monthly one-day silent retreat, longer weekend retreats through the year, self-guided personal retreat stays and long-form teacher training. Retreat days fold in bush walks on the property.
listings._source: kookaburrayoga.com — ten-acre bushland property, seasonal creek, octagonal shala, retreat and training program list and $25 casual class price confirmed on the business's own site. Third-party directories list 210 Carradine Road, Bedfordale and 08 9399 1000, but neither appears on the business's own pages, so address and phone are left blank pending confirmation. Distinct from Restful Waters (also Bedfordale, already listed in batch 2) — different property, domain and phone.
